title: Parwana
desc: Parwana spends his days brightening the lives of the downtrodden with a series of odd jobs. Just as Parwana falls in love and marries the girl of his dreams, a group of vicious criminals label him a traitor and Parwana is thrown behind bars. Despite the mafia's best attempts to permanently silent Parwana as he languishes in jail, the daring hero escapes and sets out on a mission to clear his name and expose the real criminals.

title: Maidan E Jung
desc: Arjun learns that his sister loves a man who is about to get married and makes efforts to unite them. But when he learns that his sister's in-laws plan to kill her, he sets out to teach them a lesson.

title: Zakhmi Insan (dub) (dass Tamil)
desc: Antony falls in love with Rajeswari who belongs to an upper caste family. When her father kills her sister for marrying a man from the lower caste, she decides to elope with Antony.
